name: Animal compendium
summary: The game logs 255 animals across eight categories, filled in by studying each one through binoculars.
body: PowerPyx gives the split as 61 hunts, 60 birds, 35 fish, 34 cats and dogs, 18 mammals, 18 aquatic, 6 reptiles and 23 others.
PowerPyx says animals are studied with the binoculars from the weapon wheel, that hunting or skinning is not needed, and that every dog and cat breed is counted separately.
According to PowerPyx, studying 100 of the 255 is enough for the completion checklist.
Before launch, Gfinity Esports reported from Game Informer's Rockstar interview that the world holds more than 170 species; the two figures count different things and are not directly comparable.

name: Unique animals
summary: Eight one-of-a-kind animals exist as hunting targets, and a Survival challenge asks the player to kill all of them.
body: PowerPyx lists a Legendary Hunter challenge for killing all 8 unique animals and a Fair Game trophy for hunting a unique animal for Bret.
PowerPyx does not name the eight animals.

name: Wild boar
summary: A wild pig seen in pre-launch footage and named as a hunting target in one of the game's Survival challenges.
body: Red Bull and Gfinity Esports both listed boar among the animals shown or named by Rockstar before launch.
PowerPyx lists a Hunting Spree challenge that requires killing a boar, a rattlesnake and a panther within 15 minutes.

facts.menu_text: Bulky and aggressive, the wild boar can be found foraging in forests and wetlands throughout Leonida, and is mostly nocturnal. Because of its tendency to charge unwary humans, it is safest to hunt at long range.

name: Rattlesnake
summary: A snake named as one of three kill targets in the Hunting Spree challenge.
body: PowerPyx lists a Hunting Spree challenge that requires killing a boar, a rattlesnake and a panther within 15 minutes without taking damage from enemies or animals.
Red Bull and Gfinity Esports listed snakes in general among the animals shown before launch, without naming a kind.

DayOne's hunting guide (November 18, 2026) names the species as the Eastern Diamondback Rattlesnake, found in coastal and forest areas, and recommends the Wortham W-22 for it; GTA Tracker's wildlife database lists it under the same name.

name: Cat
summary: Domestic cats appear in several breeds, and each breed is a separate entry in the animal list.
body: PowerPyx says each cat and dog breed counts on its own, with 34 cat and dog entries in total.
Red Bull and Gfinity Esports both listed cats among the animals shown or named before launch.

name: Manatee
summary: A large, slow water mammal shown in Rockstar's pre-launch footage and artwork.
body: Red Bull cites a screenshot and diving footage showing manatees and links them to the inland waters of the Grassrivers.
Gfinity Esports says manatees appeared in earlier trailers and artwork and were also named in Game Informer's Rockstar interview.

name: Dolphin
summary: A sea mammal shown before launch; the Vice City Oceanarium also keeps a dolphin tank.
body: Red Bull and Gfinity Esports both listed dolphins among the animals shown or named before launch, and Red Bull places them in the open sea.
PowerPyx lists a vehicle challenge that involves parachuting into the orca or dolphin tank at the Vice City Oceanarium.

facts.habitat: Open sea; Vice City Oceanarium tank

name: Orca
summary: An orca tank is part of the Vice City Oceanarium.
body: PowerPyx lists an Oceanarium Jump challenge that requires parachuting into the orca or dolphin tank at the Vice City Oceanarium.

facts.menu_text: Recognizable by its sleek profile and black and white coloration, the orca is an apex predator that hunts using echolocation. The most famous orca in Leonida is the star attraction at Vice City Oceanarium.

name: Shark
summary: Sharks live in the sea around Leonida and were shown in pre-launch material.
body: Red Bull and Gfinity Esports both listed sharks before launch; Red Bull said how dangerous they are was not yet known.

name: Whale
summary: Whales are among the sea animals shown or named before launch.
body: Red Bull and Gfinity Esports both listed whales among the game's sea life.

name: Jellyfish
summary: Jellyfish are among the sea animals shown or named before launch.
body: Red Bull and Gfinity Esports both listed jellyfish among the game's sea life.

name: Eel
summary: Eels are among the water animals shown or named before launch.
body: Red Bull and Gfinity Esports both listed eels among the game's aquatic animals.

name: Flamingo
summary: A pink wading bird shown in trailers and artwork well before launch.
body: Red Bull and Gfinity Esports both listed flamingos, with Gfinity noting they were visible in earlier trailers and artwork.
The live birds are separate from the Cocaine Flamingo collectibles, which PowerPyx describes as flamingo figures rather than animals.

name: Pelican
summary: A large water bird shown in trailers and artwork before launch.
body: Red Bull and Gfinity Esports both listed pelicans, with Gfinity noting they were visible in earlier trailers and artwork.
The Tampa Bay Times' reporters say they saw both brown pelicans and American white pelicans in the released game, and that the pelicans flick their bills.

name: Spoonbill
summary: A wetland bird among those shown or named before launch.
body: Red Bull and Gfinity Esports both listed spoonbills among the game's birds.

name: Crane
summary: A tall wetland bird among those shown or named before launch.
body: Red Bull and Gfinity Esports both listed cranes among the game's birds.
The Tampa Bay Times' environment reporters, birding in the released game with Florida field guides, identified the cranes they saw as whooping cranes.

name: Duck
summary: Ducks are among the water birds shown or named before launch.
body: Red Bull and Gfinity Esports both listed ducks among the game's birds.

name: Seagull
summary: Seagulls are among the birds shown or named before launch.
body: Red Bull and Gfinity Esports both listed seagulls among the game's birds.
The Tampa Bay Times' reporters identified herring gulls and laughing gulls among the birds they found in the released game.

name: Woodpecker
summary: Woodpeckers are among the birds shown or named before launch.
body: Red Bull and Gfinity Esports both listed woodpeckers among the game's animals.

name: Armadillo
summary: A small armored mammal among the land animals shown or named before launch.
body: Red Bull listed the armadillo from trailers and screenshots, and Gfinity Esports reported the nine-banded armadillo from Game Informer's Rockstar interview.
DayOne's hunting guide (November 18, 2026) lists the Nine-Banded Armadillo as a huntable forest animal and recommends the Wortham W-22 for it.

name: Raccoon
summary: Raccoons are among the land animals shown or named before launch.
body: Red Bull and Gfinity Esports both listed raccoons among the game's land animals.

name: Otter
summary: Otters are among the animals shown or named before launch.
body: Red Bull and Gfinity Esports both listed otters among the game's animals.

name: Beaver
summary: Beavers are among the animals shown or named before launch.
body: Red Bull and Gfinity Esports both listed beavers among the game's animals.

name: Squirrel
summary: Squirrels are among the small animals shown or named before launch.
body: Red Bull and Gfinity Esports both listed squirrels among the game's animals.

DayOne's hunting guide (November 18, 2026) names the species as the Eastern Gray Squirrel, found in coastal, forest, urban and wetland areas, and recommends the Wortham W-22 for it; GTA Tracker's wildlife database lists it under the same name.

name: Iguana
summary: Iguanas are among the reptiles shown or named before launch.
body: Red Bull listed the green iguana from trailers and screenshots, and Gfinity Esports reported iguanas from Game Informer's Rockstar interview.
DayOne's hunting guide (November 18, 2026) lists the Green Iguana as huntable in coastal, urban and wetland areas and recommends the Wortham W-22 for it.

name: Rhesus macaque
summary: A monkey species among the animals shown or named before launch.
body: Red Bull and Gfinity Esports both listed rhesus macaques among the game's animals.

facts.menu_text: A small monkey native to Southeast Asia, the rhesus macaque is highly gregarious, and is recognizable by its bright pink face. A few can be found in captivity.

name: Cane toad
summary: A large toad among the animals shown or named before launch.
body: Gfinity Esports reported cane toads from Game Informer's Rockstar interview; Red Bull listed the same animal under its other common name, the aga toad.

facts.menu_text: Found predominantly in wetlands, the cane toad is the largest species of toad in the world, and will eat almost anything. Overpowered weapons will ruin the carcass.
